topic: What if all the ice on Earth melted? Scientists estimate sea levels would rise by about 70 metres, changing every coastline.

episode.title: What If All Earth's Ice Melted?

shots.narration: What if all the ice on Earth melted?
shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, glowing Earth hologram between Nova and Byte, no text.
shots.action: Nova reveals a holographic Earth with gleaming polar ice.
shots.mood: Bright cyan light, vivid purple accents, curious anticipation.

shots.narration: Scientists think complete melting would take a very long time.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a large Earth hologram showing thick ice sheets, vertical composition, no text.
shots.action: Nova slowly turns a holographic dial that gradually shrinks the ice sheets.
shots.mood: Patient wonder, soft blue glow, clear scientific demonstration.

shots.narration: [surprised] Floating sea ice barely changes sea levels when it melts.
shots.scene: Lab demonstration hologram of a transparent ocean basin with floating ice and a fixed rim, no markings or text.
shots.action: Nova dissolves the floating ice while the water surface stays nearly unchanged.
shots.mood: Playful surprise, sparkling turquoise water, clean visual contrast.

shots.narration: But melting land ice adds extra water to the oceans.
shots.scene: Colourful lab, holographic cutaway of an ice-covered continent beside an ocean basin, no text.
shots.action: Nova channels glowing meltwater from the land ice into the ocean.
shots.mood: Clear discovery, bright flowing blue water, focused curiosity.

shots.narration: Scientists think seas would rise by about 70 metres.
shots.scene: Lab with a tall holographic coastal cross-section, original shoreline outlined by a thin amber contour, no text or numbers.
shots.action: Nova raises the holographic ocean far above the original shoreline.
shots.mood: Astonishing scale, luminous blue water, thoughtful rather than threatening.

shots.narration: [excited] Every coastline would change as water spreads across low land.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a large holographic globe showing detailed continents and shallow coastal plains, no text.
shots.action: Nova sweeps her hand around the globe as its coastlines retreat inland.
shots.mood: Expansive wonder, emerald continents, brilliant blue oceans.

shots.narration: Many coastal cities would have areas below the new sea.
shots.scene: Lab hologram of an unoccupied miniature coastal city with hills behind it, no people, brands or text.
shots.action: Nova lifts a transparent water layer over the city's low districts.
shots.mood: Calm seriousness, clear water, warm buildings, no destruction.

shots.narration: Higher ground becomes coastline, reshaping habitats and human settlements.
shots.scene: Colourful lab, holographic landscape with submerged lowlands and green hills bordering a new bay, no text.
shots.action: Nova traces the newly formed shoreline with a glowing pointer.
shots.mood: Reflective discovery, sunlit green hills, peaceful blue bay.

shots.narration: [surprised] Most ice is Antarctic—what if Earth's oceans froze instead?
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a holographic Earth centred on Antarctica, surrounding oceans visible, vertical frame, no text.
shots.action: Nova transforms the hologram from highlighted Antarctic ice to frozen oceans.
shots.mood: Surprising icy sparkle, bright curiosity, inviting cliffhanger.

episode.endHook: What if Earth's oceans froze instead?
episode.description: Dr. Nova shows Byte how melting land ice could redraw Earth's coastlines. Scientists estimate seas would rise by about 70 metres if all the ice melted—but floating sea ice tells a different story.
